# Knowledge map: USB / DWC3 EP0 control path (Track B UVC/PTP)

<!-- Generated by `python -m tools.research.knowledge_map build` from `docs/map/sources/usb-ep0.toml`. Do not edit by hand. -->

- **Scope:** Why the authored UVC+PTP composite (054C:0322) on the ILCE-6400 cannot stream: the UVC VS_PROBE GET_CUR control transfer stalls ~5 s, SET_CUR is canceled, and EP0 then wedges. Covers the DWC3 EP0 state machine in the stock kernel, our bridge module, the physical runs B2..B25, and the open fix E0476.
- **Target:** ILCE-6400, kernel 3.0.27_nl-rt106 (retained live-vmlinux.bin, file_off = VA - 0x60108000)
- **Evidence span:** E0354-E0476; last reviewed 2026-11-22.
- **Deep review:** 55 of 55 records read in full and checked claim by claim ([curation plan](CURATION_PLAN.md)); the rest are curated from titles, lead paragraphs and consolidated documents.
- **Not covered here:** Earlier composite/PC Remote work (E0132-E0343), the native USB debugger (E0090, E0400-E0403), QEMU USB modelling (E0579-E0598, E0655) and the L3 OTG SET_MODE stop (E0534). Those need their own map areas.
- **Status legend:** PHYSICAL = observed on the camera/host; OFFLINE = disassembly, Unicorn or static proof; INFERENCE = argued from evidence, not observed directly; RETRACTED/REFUTED = do not rely on, kept to prevent re-derivation.

The evidence records are authoritative; follow the links before acting on a claim.

### <a id="f01"></a>F01 - Run B26: does the status pre-arm remove the 5 s stall?

- **State:** `blocked-on-user-go`
- **Candidate:** artifacts/native/uvc-transport-e0472-status-prearm/usbg_video_a6400_shared_candidate.ko, 83,644 B, sha256 dcc2f64f944790dd1b8519b29ee6f6ce709a03129fb92d363fdafe14f16915cd
- **Verified so far:** Static audit 117/8/0, Unicorn 8/8 PASS (kernel-side snippets are hand-assembled model stubs), 13 unit tests, full suite 1576 OK. No live behavior claimed.
- **Preflight:** Harness tools/research/run_b26_uvc_prearm.py pins the module and the daemon (a6400-lived, 632,812 B, sha256 1eda8418...). Local observation 2026-11-22, not an evidence record: camera-daemon/build/a6400-lived was 856,320 B, sha256 c92403f6..., so verify_local_artifacts() fails and tests/emulator/test_run_b26_uvc_prearm.py reports it. Restore or re-pin the daemon before any GO.
- **Next:** One supervised Run B26 after explicit user GO, same harness as B25 (wait for 054C:0322, ETW started before the PC Remote switch, one ffmpeg attempt, SD log).
- **Read in the result:** PREARM st=2 nx=3 r=1 before the GET_CUR status completion; RAMRING ... prearm=1/1/0 st=2 nx=3; ETL GET_CUR URB duration << 5 s.

- H2: the armed TRB never ACKs a later Status OUT. Then B26 shows PREARM r=1 and still no status completion.

## Entities

### <a id="problem-get-cur-5s"></a>UVC VS_PROBE GET_CUR stalls 5.0 s

`problem.get-cur-5s` | problem

First class request after enumeration, GET_CUR(VS_PROBE_CONTROL) 26 B on interface 2, takes 5.000-5.012 s on the host; SET_CUR is then canceled after another ~5 s; later retries fail fast with XACT_ERROR; ffmpeg reports 'Could not RenderStream to connect pins'. Reproduced in B14, B18, B19, B20, B21, B24, B25.

Aliases: `5 s stall`, `GET_CUR timeout`, `RenderStream fails`, `A1 81 0100 0002 001A`

Current knowledge:

- **C01** `PHYSICAL` The camera's data stage of GET_CUR completes in about 1 ms (actual=26, status=0); the delay is not in the data stage. ([E0365](../evidence/0365-run-b9-status-stage-silent-noop-and-status-kick.md), [E0392](../evidence/0392-runb18-ramring-and-full-etl-verdict.md), [E0471](../evidence/0471-b25-status-out-hang-forensics-status-handshake-window.md))
- **C02** `PHYSICAL` After the GET_CUR data stage, ep0state goes 2->3 (status TRB armed on eps0 OUT, STARTTRANSFER accepted) within 16.388 ms, then nothing changes for 5000.010 ms until the host aborts and sends the next SETUP (verdict S1). ([E0468](../evidence/0468-runb25-ep0-observer-s1-verdict.md), [E0471](../evidence/0471-b25-status-out-hang-forensics-status-handshake-window.md))
- **C03** `PHYSICAL` The 5.000 s is the Windows control-transfer timeout: Stop Endpoint + Set TR Dequeue at +5.000417 s, URB completes SUCCESS 26 B via the cancel path; SET_CUR then canceled 0xC0010000; retries fail with XACT_ERROR 0xC0000011. ([E0382](../evidence/0382-do-control-status-and-xhci-5s-status-stage.md), [E0393](../evidence/0393-b18-full-etl-and-ramring-bytes.md), [E0458](../evidence/0458-runb24-ep0-observer-inconclusive-and-dwc3-null-deref-reboot.md), [E0471](../evidence/0471-b25-status-out-hang-forensics-status-handshake-window.md))
- **C04** `INFERENCE` Root cause: missed Status OUT handshake. The host sends its single Status OUT right after DATA-IN, before the threaded IRQ arms the status TRB; DWC3 NAKs it (recorded NRDY(STATUS)); no later Status OUT completes the armed TRB. ([E0471](../evidence/0471-b25-status-out-hang-forensics-status-handshake-window.md)) *Note: Strongly supported but not directly observed: ETW has no NAK/per-TRB trace and OBS samples every ~10 ms.*
- **C07** `INFERENCE` Descriptors and the composite layout are not implicated in the 5 s stall. ([E0471](../evidence/0471-b25-status-out-hang-forensics-status-handshake-window.md), [E0389](../evidence/0389-b17-etl-decode-and-uvc-descriptor-validation.md))
- **C13** `PHYSICAL` Fast XACT_ERROR GET_CUR retries are the post-wedge signature; a capture that starts after enumeration misses the initial 5 s transfer. Always capture ETW from before the PC Remote switch. ([E0390](../evidence/0390-e0386-vs-e0388-diff-and-b17-capture-window.md), [E0393](../evidence/0393-b18-full-etl-and-ramring-bytes.md))
- **C16** `OFFLINE` Tooling for the 5 s hypothesis: a fail-closed CLASS abort guard (holds before unbind/free/reconnect when a CLASS request may still be outstanding; Unicorn teardown suite 13/13), camera-side CLASS/VENDOR setup and START/STOP logging, and a crash-safe --dmesg-sd kernel trace to A6400K.LOG. Unicorn shows core_cb_class returns 0 synchronously for probe/commit with no deferred queue inside it. ([E0355](../evidence/0355-offline-etl-abortguard-wpd.md), [E0356](../evidence/0356-offline-ep0-trace-prep-and-unicorn-verdict.md))
- **C23** `INFERENCE` Synthesis: clear_halt_ep0 cannot re-arm EP0; the 5 s gap is the GET_CUR URB itself and the missing event is GET's status completion, after which SET_CUR is canceled. ([E0381](../evidence/0381-clear-halt-ep0-disasm-and-b14-etl-decode.md)) *Note: Consistent with the later S1 verdict (C02).*
- **C26** `PHYSICAL` GET_DESCRIPTOR completes data and status in 1.4-3.8 ms while GET_CUR's data completes in about 1 ms and the host then waits about 5.01 s; both carry the same request flag byte (req+0x1a = 02) in the early RAM ring. The gap before GET_CUR is the host's configuration window; UCX emits no SELECT_* records, so SET_CONFIGURATION/SET_INTERFACE are not directly visible, and no PTP interface-0 transfer appears. ([E0394](../evidence/0394-get-descriptor-vs-get-cur-status-diff.md), [E0396](../evidence/0396-get-descriptor-vs-get-cur-ramring.md), [E0397](../evidence/0397-b20-etl-and-set-config-ep0-diff.md))
- **C30** `OFFLINE` With the UCX provider and tracerpt XML, control URBs can be extracted with their setup packets, durations and USBD_STATUS (B17/B18 decodes). ([E0389](../evidence/0389-b17-etl-decode-and-uvc-descriptor-validation.md), [E0393](../evidence/0393-b18-full-etl-and-ramring-bytes.md))
- **C31** `PHYSICAL` Run B3 saw exactly one CLASS request per session, GET_CUR VS_PROBE (A1 81 0100 0002 001A), arriving with raw wire wIndex 2 while the reference expects native interface 1; the bridge now translates wire 2 -> native 1 (module 2be32cac, Unicorn selector 23/23, bridge 12/12, reference-class 10/10). In Run B4 the translation is live and the host proceeds to SET_CUR(PROBE) exactly +5.002 s later; no COMMIT or SET_INTERFACE follows. ([E0357](../evidence/0357-run-b3-get-cur-never-delivered-and-class-translation-fix.md), [E0359](../evidence/0359-run-b4-translation-live-probe-bug-and-clean-teardown.md))
- **C37** `OFFLINE` Run B14 host ETL (UCX): only five control URBs to 054C:0322 in 229 s. GET_CUR VS_PROBE stays pending 5.010962 s and completes SUCCESS with 26 bytes; SET_CUR is submitted 17 us later and canceled after 5.009888 s (0xC0010000); then GET_CUR and PTP class requests fail in about 2.3 ms with XACT_ERROR. No host request lies between GET_CUR and SET_CUR, and the device finished the GET data stage about 5 s before the host URB completed. ([E0381](../evidence/0381-clear-halt-ep0-disasm-and-b14-etl-decode.md))
- **C43** `PHYSICAL` The e0388 build (eda3f8d6) removed every hot-path hook (no ops shadow, queue wrapper, completion thunk or printk; the 26-byte OUT data uses the stock bounce path). With a zero-printk RAM ring (B18) GET data still completes in 0.95 ms and SET_CUR still starts 5.011 s later, so our instrumentation was not the cause of the stall. ([E0388](../evidence/0388-clean-ep0-build-and-run-b17.md), [E0392](../evidence/0392-runb18-ramring-and-full-etl-verdict.md))

Do not rely on:

- ~~S2: the IRQ thread handles the status events ~5 s late (scheduling/priority problem).~~ **R01** `REFUTED` ([E0446](../evidence/0446-ep0-event-ring-decode-sequence-model-and-readonly-observer.md), [E0468](../evidence/0468-runb25-ep0-observer-s1-verdict.md)); see C02: After the GET_CUR data stage, ep0state goes 2->3 (status TRB armed on eps0 OUT, STARTTRANSFER accepted) within 16.388 ms, then nothing changes for 5000.010 ms until the host aborts and sends the next SETUP (verdict S1).
- ~~The clean e0388 build fixed the 5 s timeout (B17 GET_CUR failed in 2.9 ms with XACT_ERROR).~~ **R07** `RETRACTED` ([E0389](../evidence/0389-b17-etl-decode-and-uvc-descriptor-validation.md)); see C13: Fast XACT_ERROR GET_CUR retries are the post-wedge signature; a capture that starts after enumeration misses the initial 5 s transfer. Always capture ETW from before the PC Remote switch.
- ~~Run B3: GET_CUR(PROBE) was answered with 0 and never delivered to the host.~~ **R08** `RETRACTED` ([E0357](../evidence/0357-run-b3-get-cur-never-delivered-and-class-translation-fix.md)); see C01: The camera's data stage of GET_CUR completes in about 1 ms (actual=26, status=0); the delay is not in the data stage. *Note: E0357's erratum (E0358) corrects the gadgetcore framing and the 181-TID park claim; Run B9 (E0365) and the B18 RAM ring (E0392) show the GET_CUR data stage completes in about 1 ms.*
- ~~The 5 s gap comes from a delayed IRQ thread plus a ctrl_req overwrite: a zero-length standard control transfer (SET_INTERFACE/SET_CONFIGURATION) between GET_CUR and SET_CUR leaves the control pipe out of sync.~~ **R16** `REFUTED` ([E0375](../evidence/0375-setup-req-driver-offsets-status-path-and-ctrlreq-hypothesis.md), [E0378](../evidence/0378-setup-req-a3f0-and-core-cb-start-ep0-queue.md)); see C37: Run B14 host ETL (UCX): only five control URBs to 054C:0322 in 229 s. GET_CUR VS_PROBE stays pending 5.010962 s and completes SUCCESS with 26 bytes; SET_CUR is submitted 17 us later and canceled after 5.009888 s (0xC0010000); then GET_CUR and PTP class requests fail in about 2.3 ms with XACT_ERROR. No host request lies between GET_CUR and SET_CUR, and the device finished the GET data stage about 5 s before the host URB completed. *Note: The B14 ETL has no host request between GET_CUR and SET_CUR, and GET_CUR returned its 26 bytes correctly.*
- ~~The 5 s stall is induced by our synchronous EP0 instrumentation: about eight printks before returning to the event loop delay the status arm, the host's Status OUT is NAKed, and it retries only at its 5 s timeout.~~ **R20** `REFUTED` ([E0387](../evidence/0387-own-code-and-uvc-descriptor-audit.md)); see C43: The e0388 build (eda3f8d6) removed every hot-path hook (no ops shadow, queue wrapper, completion thunk or printk; the 26-byte OUT data uses the stock bounce path). With a zero-printk RAM ring (B18) GET data still completes in 0.95 ms and SET_CUR still starts 5.011 s later, so our instrumentation was not the cause of the stall. *Note: The handshake-window idea returns in E0471 with stock timing (status armed within 16.388 ms); only the 'instrumentation causes it' part is refuted.*

### <a id="dwc3-ep0"></a>DWC3 EP0 control state machine (stock kernel)

`dwc3.ep0` | device

Stock Synopsys DWC3 gadget backport in the a6400 kernel. ep0state 1=setup, 2=data, 3=status; ep0_next_event at dwc+0x2dc. The status TRB is armed only from the XferNotReady(STATUS) handler (or the delayed_status queue path).

Aliases: `ep0state`, `ep0_next_event`, `dwc3_ep0_interrupt`

Current knowledge:

- **C01** `PHYSICAL` The camera's data stage of GET_CUR completes in about 1 ms (actual=26, status=0); the delay is not in the data stage. ([E0365](../evidence/0365-run-b9-status-stage-silent-noop-and-status-kick.md), [E0392](../evidence/0392-runb18-ramring-and-full-etl-verdict.md), [E0471](../evidence/0471-b25-status-out-hang-forensics-status-handshake-window.md))
- **C02** `PHYSICAL` After the GET_CUR data stage, ep0state goes 2->3 (status TRB armed on eps0 OUT, STARTTRANSFER accepted) within 16.388 ms, then nothing changes for 5000.010 ms until the host aborts and sends the next SETUP (verdict S1). ([E0468](../evidence/0468-runb25-ep0-observer-s1-verdict.md), [E0471](../evidence/0471-b25-status-out-hang-forensics-status-handshake-window.md))
- **C04** `INFERENCE` Root cause: missed Status OUT handshake. The host sends its single Status OUT right after DATA-IN, before the threaded IRQ arms the status TRB; DWC3 NAKs it (recorded NRDY(STATUS)); no later Status OUT completes the armed TRB. ([E0471](../evidence/0471-b25-status-out-hang-forensics-status-handshake-window.md)) *Note: Strongly supported but not directly observed: ETW has no NAK/per-TRB trace and OBS samples every ~10 ms.*
- **C05** `OFFLINE` With stock code the first status token is NAKed too: complete_data never arms a status TRB, only the NRDY(STATUS) and delayed_status paths call do_control_status. A faster req->complete cannot prevent the NAK. ([E0386](../evidence/0386-retraction-probe-induced-nak-and-vendor-status-path.md))
- **C06** `OFFLINE` The DWC3 status programming is correct: STATUS3 (0x40) for three-stage, direction from the dep argument, OUT len = maxpacket 64 on ctrl_req, ctrl 0xC43 (HWO|LST|IOC|ISP_IMI). Same path stock reads use successfully. ([E0471](../evidence/0471-b25-status-out-hang-forensics-status-handshake-window.md), [E0382](../evidence/0382-do-control-status-and-xhci-5s-status-stage.md), [E0366](../evidence/0366-pre-b10-verification-kick-unsafe-and-set-data-out-zero-progress.md))
- **C11** `OFFLINE` Replaying the observed event order through the real vmlinux dwc3_ep0_interrupt arms the status stage cleanly (2->3->1); the stall is not an EP0 software state-machine or queue bug. NRDY(status) before data-complete would NULL-deref, which was never seen live. ([E0446](../evidence/0446-ep0-event-ring-decode-sequence-model-and-readonly-observer.md))
- **C12** `OFFLINE` dep0->request_list was empty before queue; req 609d0240 is our own freshly queued class request. Do not drop or drain it. ([E0380](../evidence/0380-ep0-queue-timing-and-req-609d0240-identity.md))
- **C17** `OFFLINE` The EP0 queue target is the UDC, not gadgetcore: ep0->ops is dwc3_gadget_ep0_ops and its queue slot is dwc3_gadget_ep0_queue 0x602b2ad0 -> __dwc3_gadget_ep0_queue 0x602b26ec. It validates only structural EP0 state (-108 / -16) and returns 0 on three paths that arm no transfer, so a class result of 0 does not prove the reply was submitted. core_cb_class never reads its r0 argument and always uses the singleton this_ex reply buffer. ([E0358](../evidence/0358-offline-ep0-queue-target-and-park-recovery.md))
- **C18** `PHYSICAL` Runs B4-B7: translated GET_CUR still timed out with clean teardown; both EP0 transfers armed (next=1, BUSY) but SET had dma=0 because both request-prep paths leave dma=0 and the UDC maps only IN; an OUT DMA wrapper fixed the mapping yet both transfers still timed out. ([E0359](../evidence/0359-run-b4-translation-live-probe-bug-and-clean-teardown.md), [E0360](../evidence/0360-run-b5-armed-transfers-dma-gap.md), [E0361](../evidence/0361-run-b6-dma-disassembly-and-queue-wrapper.md), [E0362](../evidence/0362-run-b7-out-dma-wrapper-and-completion-thunk.md))
- **C20** `OFFLINE` Corrected lpos timeline for Run B12 (lpos is the currently executing event): GET's NRDY(STATUS) at 0x29c arrived after the data completion set next=3, so ep0state became 3 and the status TRB was armed in that same batch; an ep0 XferComplete at 0x2a0 later retired it, ahead of SET_CUR's SETUP at 0x2a4. B12 does not show when 0x2a0 happened; B25 (E0471) shows the retirement only after the host's Stop Endpoint. SET's completion is a separate puzzle (C42). ### <a id="fn-do-control-status"></a>__dwc3_ep0_do_control_status

`fn.do-control-status` | function | address `0x602b253c` | inventory `kernel.text:__dwc3_ep0_do_control_status`, `kernel.dwc3:__dwc3_ep0_do_control_status`

ABI r0 = struct dwc3 *dwc, r1 = struct dwc3_ep *dep. Only two callers: 0x602b34b0 (NRDY STATUS, after writing ep0state=3 at 0x602b3454) and 0x602b27f0 (delayed_status queue path, needs dwc+0x2d8 bit5).

Current knowledge:

- **C06** `OFFLINE` The DWC3 status programming is correct: STATUS3 (0x40) for three-stage, direction from the dep argument, OUT len = maxpacket 64 on ctrl_req, ctrl 0xC43 (HWO|LST|IOC|ISP_IMI). Same path stock reads use successfully. ### <a id="fn-start-trans"></a>dwc3_ep0_start_trans

`fn.start-trans` | function | address `0x602b2424` | inventory `kernel.text:dwc3_ep0_start_trans`, `kernel.dwc3:dwc3_ep0_start_trans`

Writes the TRB first, then issues DEPCMD STARTTRANSFER via send_gadget_ep_cmd 0x602b0220 (polls 500x, -110 on timeout). On success sets dep BUSY (flags |= 0x10), resource index, next=1. A BUSY dep makes a second arm a silent no-op.

Current knowledge:

- **C14** `OFFLINE` start_trans returns negative with no side effects only when DEPCMD times out (-110); dwc3_send_gadget_ep_cmd keeps only CMDACT and returns 0, so a hardware-rejected STARTTRANSFER (DEPCMD CmdStatus != 0) would still set dep BUSY, the resource index and next=1 with no warning. ([E0386](../evidence/0386-retraction-probe-induced-nak-and-vendor-status-path.md))
- **C39** `PHYSICAL` Run B16 sampled DEPCMD0/DEPCMD1 at every probe point: CmdStatus 0 with valid XferRscIdx (0 and 1) throughout, so no hardware-rejected STARTTRANSFER explains the stall. ([E0386](../evidence/0386-runb16-depcmd-cmdstatus-and-ring-verdict.md))

Do not rely on:

- ~~The control status ZLP never starts: dwc3_ep0_start_trans silently no-ops through its DWC3_EP_BUSY early return or an ignored DEPCMD rejection.~~ **R14** `REFUTED` ([E0364](../evidence/0364-corrected-gadget-abi-and-status-stage-noop.md), [E0365](../evidence/0365-run-b9-status-stage-silent-noop-and-status-kick.md)); see C02: After the GET_CUR data stage, ep0state goes 2->3 (status TRB armed on eps0 OUT, STARTTRANSFER accepted) within 16.388 ms, then nothing changes for 5000.010 ms until the host aborts and sends the next SETUP (verdict S1). *Note: E0386 finds no rejected STARTTRANSFER; E0446 and Run B25 (E0468) show the stock code arms the status TRB within 16.388 ms.*

- **C36** `OFFLINE` XferComplete dispatches only on ep0state (dwc+0x2e0): 2 -> complete_data, 3 -> status-complete (give back any eps0 request, ep0state=1, out_start), 1 -> setup completion; nothing checks the event's transfer identity or TRB ownership. dwc3_gadget_giveback has seven call sites; the EP0 data completion uses 0x602b3344 with the event status. ### <a id="field-dwc-2d8"></a>struct dwc3 flags byte at dwc+0x2d8

`field.dwc-2d8` | field | address `dwc+0x2d8`

bit0 three_stage_setup (selects STATUS3 0x40 vs STATUS2 0x30, not direction); bit1 ep0_bounced; bit2 ep0_expect_in; bit3 start_config_issued; bit4 setup_packet_pending; bit5 delayed_status; bit6 resize_fifos; bit7 pullups. dwc+0x2dc is ep0_next_event and dwc+0x2e0 is ep0state.

The one TRB slot is reused for SETUP, DATA and STATUS (dwc3_ep0_out_start re-arms SETUP into it). Event words decode as type=(w>>6)&0xf (1 XferComplete, 3 XferNotReady), epnum=(w>>1)&0x1f, NRDY subtype byte1 bits 4-7 (1 DATA, 2 STATUS). ([E0368](../evidence/0368-run-b10-probe-unicorn-pass-and-dma-space-trb-gap.md), [E0369](../evidence/0369-run-b11-probe-exact-trb-hwo-values.md), [E0371](../evidence/0371-run-b12-gevnt-double-queue-and-stale-completion.md), [E0376](../evidence/0376-core-cb-start-disasm-and-setup-req-contradiction.md), [E0381](../evidence/0381-clear-halt-ep0-disasm-and-b14-etl-decode.md))

### <a id="fn-setup-req"></a>gadgetcore setup_req / make_device_desc

`fn.setup-req` | function | address `0x602b94a4` | inventory `kernel.text:setup_req`, `kernel.text:make_device_desc`

Sony gadgetcore standard-request dispatcher. Class requests do not pass setup_req 0x9b64; they dispatch from the class/vendor branch 0x602b9ffc via [class_obj+0x2c]. make_device_desc (0x602bb988) dereferences gc->desc_tbl (gc+0x6c) with no NULL check.

Aliases: `make_device_desc`, `0x602bb988`, `g_setup`, `gcw_setup`

Current knowledge:

- **C09** `OFFLINE` Class requests dispatch from the class/vendor branch 0x602b9ffc via [class_obj+0x2c], never through setup_req 0x9b64. ([E0377](../evidence/0377-gadgetcore-register-struct-and-setup-req-dispatch.md))
- **C15** `PHYSICAL` The E0465 restore guard fires in a shared-PTP session ('no legacy Mass Storage table saved ... legacy restore skipped'); no EP0 re-arm over a NULL table and no reboot (Run B25). ([E0465](../evidence/0465-runb24-null-deref-root-cause-and-offline-fixes.md), [E0468](../evidence/0468-runb25-ep0-observer-s1-verdict.md))
- **C21** `PHYSICAL` Run B13: gadgetcore's ep0 is the same object as the class ep0 (68a1c9c0, eq=1). setup_req's delegated queue at 0x9fd8 (caller LR 602b9fdc) is real but was observed only for standard enumeration requests (lengths 18, 39, 26, 4, 20, 9, 0), never during GET_CUR/SET_CUR. The camera rebooted after that run's otherwise clean teardown. ([E0374](../evidence/0374-run-b13-gc-context-and-second-queue-proof.md), [E0375](../evidence/0375-setup-req-driver-offsets-status-path-and-ctrlreq-hypothesis.md))
- **C22** `OFFLINE` setup_req branches on bmRequestType & 0x60: standard requests use the bRequest jump table, and SET_CONFIGURATION/SET_INTERFACE reach the driver loop that calls [driver+0x18] = core_cb_start at 0x602b9b64 (return 0 leads to the delegated status queue at 0x9fd8). Class/vendor requests go to 0x602b9ffc and call [class_obj+0x2c] = core_cb_class; a class return of 0 only calls clear_halt_ep0 (one store of 0 to gc+0x83) and cannot stall, restart or re-arm EP0. No +0x34 callback is used. B12-B16 logs show one standard delegated queue (lr 602b9fdc) per request, so a double queue during START is not demonstrated. ([E0391](../evidence/0391-start-core-cb-start-and-pre-class-enumeration.md))

It was not an EP0 timeout. ([E0458](../evidence/0458-runb24-ep0-observer-inconclusive-and-dwc3-null-deref-reboot.md), [E0465](../evidence/0465-runb24-null-deref-root-cause-and-offline-fixes.md))

`module.usbg-video` | module

Our module built with --shared-ptp-enumeration-candidate --composite-transport. Static audit target 117 checks / 8 skipped / 0 failures. Builds of record in this area: e0446-obs 7c87ab37 (B23), e0455-obs-fixed 2c6f82e9 (B24), e0459-obs-unbuffered 3ddb6bd5 (B25), e0472-status-prearm dcc2f64f (B26 candidate).

Current knowledge:

- **C18** `PHYSICAL` Runs B4-B7: translated GET_CUR still timed out with clean teardown; both EP0 transfers armed (next=1, BUSY) but SET had dma=0 because both request-prep paths leave dma=0 and the UDC maps only IN; an OUT DMA wrapper fixed the mapping yet both transfers still timed out. ([E0359](../evidence/0359-run-b4-translation-live-probe-bug-and-clean-teardown.md), [E0360](../evidence/0360-run-b5-armed-transfers-dma-gap.md), [E0361](../evidence/0361-run-b6-dma-disassembly-and-queue-wrapper.md), [E0362](../evidence/0362-run-b7-out-dma-wrapper-and-completion-thunk.md))
- **C27** `PHYSICAL` Run B: the live START endpoint selector accepted the 0x84 bulk-IN wrapper (flags&1 set, ownership wrapper+0x24 == raw, descriptor 7,5,0x84,bulk,512); the *(dep+0x4C)&1 precondition did not reject it, so endpoint selection is not the RenderStream failure. ([E0354](../evidence/0354-run-b-selector-accepts-084-renderstream-fails.md))
- **C31** `PHYSICAL` Run B3 saw exactly one CLASS request per session, GET_CUR VS_PROBE (A1 81 0100 0002 001A), arriving with raw wire wIndex 2 while the reference expects native interface 1; the bridge now translates wire 2 -> native 1 (module 2be32cac, Unicorn selector 23/23, bridge 12/12, reference-class 10/10). In Run B4 the translation is live and the host proceeds to SET_CUR(PROBE) exactly +5.002 s later; no COMMIT or SET_INTERFACE follows. ([E0357](../evidence/0357-run-b3-get-cur-never-delivered-and-class-translation-fix.md), [E0359](../evidence/0359-run-b4-translation-live-probe-bug-and-clean-teardown.md))
- **C32** `PHYSICAL` A failed STOP attestation reports the daemon's sentinel state -1,-1,-1,-1 and parked the session without re-enumeration (Run B3 battery pull). The park-recovery daemon (99047575, 630,536 B) flushes SD evidence, writes status=degraded_teardown, retries STOP exactly once, retires the hook and always resumes; from Run B4 on, teardown was clean without needing it. ([E0357](../evidence/0357-run-b3-get-cur-never-delivered-and-class-translation-fix.md), [E0358](../evidence/0358-offline-ep0-queue-target-and-park-recovery.md), [E0359](../evidence/0359-run-b4-translation-live-probe-bug-and-clean-teardown.md))

The 26 OUT bytes do not matter to the reference (actual=0 in Run B9). ([E0361](../evidence/0361-run-b6-dma-disassembly-and-queue-wrapper.md), [E0364](../evidence/0364-corrected-gadget-abi-and-status-stage-noop.md), [E0365](../evidence/0365-run-b9-status-stage-silent-noop-and-status-kick.md))
- **C38** `OFFLINE` core_cb_start (module 0x10f0..0x11ac) has no EP0 queue, request allocation or TRB call; the 0x1318 queue belongs to the GET_CUR probe helper 0x11bc (26-byte rodata template, dwFrameInterval patch, complete=uvc_ep0_comp). B12-B16 logs show one standard delegated queue (lr 602b9fdc) per request, so a double queue during START is not demonstrated. ([E0391](../evidence/0391-start-core-cb-start-and-pre-class-enumeration.md))
- **C43** `PHYSICAL` The e0388 build (eda3f8d6) removed every hot-path hook (no ops shadow, queue wrapper, completion thunk or printk; the 26-byte OUT data uses the stock bounce path). With a zero-printk RAM ring (B18) GET data still completes in 0.95 ms and SET_CUR still starts 5.011 s later, so our instrumentation was not the cause of the stall. ([E0388](../evidence/0388-clean-ep0-build-and-run-b17.md), [E0392](../evidence/0392-runb18-ramring-and-full-etl-verdict.md))
- **C44** `OFFLINE` The reference VS_PROBE template is 26 bytes; originally dwMaxVideoFrameSize 14,745,600 and dwMaxPayloadTransferSize 300,000 disagreed with the Bulk 512 endpoint and a 1280x720 frame. e0388 aligned the reply and frame descriptor to 1,843,200 / 131,060. The VS format descriptor is the 11-byte MJPEG shape, and header endpoint 0x84, VC baInterfaceNr 2 and wTotalLength 40/61 are consistent. The stall persisted after the alignment. ([E0387](../evidence/0387-own-code-and-uvc-descriptor-audit.md), [E0388](../evidence/0388-clean-ep0-build-and-run-b17.md), [E0389](../evidence/0389-b17-etl-decode-and-uvc-descriptor-validation.md))

### <a id="host-windows-xhci"></a>Windows host xHCI control transfers

`host.windows-xhci` | host

AMD USB 3.10 xHCI, Microsoft driver stack (UCX/USBXHCI/USBHUB3). The whole control TD (Setup+Data+Status) is queued at dispatch; the control transfer timeout is 5.000 s, ending in Stop Endpoint + Set TR Dequeue Pointer. ETW has no per-TRB/NAK records.

Current knowledge:

- **C03** `PHYSICAL` The 5.000 s is the Windows control-transfer timeout: Stop Endpoint + Set TR Dequeue at +5.000417 s, URB completes SUCCESS 26 B via the cancel path; SET_CUR then canceled 0xC0010000; retries fail with XACT_ERROR 0xC0000011. ([E0382](../evidence/0382-do-control-status-and-xhci-5s-status-stage.md), [E0393](../evidence/0393-b18-full-etl-and-ramring-bytes.md), [E0458](../evidence/0458-runb24-ep0-observer-inconclusive-and-dwc3-null-deref-reboot.md), [E0471](../evidence/0471-b25-status-out-hang-forensics-status-handshake-window.md))
- **C13** `PHYSICAL` Fast XACT_ERROR GET_CUR retries are the post-wedge signature; a capture that starts after enumeration misses the initial 5 s transfer. Always capture ETW from before the PC Remote switch. ([E0390](../evidence/0390-e0386-vs-e0388-diff-and-b17-capture-window.md), [E0393](../evidence/0393-b18-full-etl-and-ramring-bytes.md))
- **C28** `PHYSICAL` In composite mode Windows PnP shows MI_00 as 'MTP USB Device' with status OK, but PortableDeviceManager lists 0 Sony WPD devices (12 retries in Run B2, again in B3-B5); the PMCA filter parses composite IDs correctly and is not the cause, so a host PTP consumer could not run during these sessions. ([E0354](../evidence/0354-run-b-selector-accepts-084-renderstream-fails.md), [E0355](../evidence/0355-offline-etl-abortguard-wpd.md), [E0357](../evidence/0357-run-b3-get-cur-never-delivered-and-class-translation-fix.md), [E0359](../evidence/0359-run-b4-translation-live-probe-bug-and-clean-teardown.md))
- **C29** `OFFLINE` USBXHCI/USBHUB3 ETW events are TRB-level (slot/endpoint/ring counters) with no setup packet or USBD_STATUS; they still show the host received the correct 173-byte composite configuration descriptor and that ffmpeg's 5.3 s abort had no bus-level reset or re-read. ([E0355](../evidence/0355-offline-etl-abortguard-wpd.md))
- **C30** `OFFLINE` With the UCX provider and tracerpt XML, control URBs can be extracted with their setup packets, durations and USBD_STATUS (B17/B18 decodes). ([E0389](../evidence/0389-b17-etl-decode-and-uvc-descriptor-validation.md), [E0393](../evidence/0393-b18-full-etl-and-ramring-bytes.md))
- **C37** `OFFLINE` Run B14 host ETL (UCX): only five control URBs to 054C:0322 in 229 s. GET_CUR VS_PROBE stays pending 5.010962 s and completes SUCCESS with 26 bytes; SET_CUR is submitted 17 us later and canceled after 5.009888 s (0xC0010000); then GET_CUR and PTP class requests fail in about 2.3 ms with XACT_ERROR. No host request lies between GET_CUR and SET_CUR, and the device finished the GET data stage about 5 s before the host URB completed. ([E0381](../evidence/0381-clear-halt-ep0-disasm-and-b14-etl-decode.md))
- **C40** `OFFLINE` On the host the whole GET_CUR control TD (Setup, Data, Status) is queued at dispatch and no event for that slot appears until the Stop Endpoint at +5.0107 s; host congestion is ruled out (another device on the same controller was serviced every ~1.06 s, maximum interrupter/DPC gap 1.013 ms). The device-side status arm is geometrically correct (STATUS3 0x0c43, len 64, ctrl_req) and dep0 was not BUSY at GET completion. ([E0382](../evidence/0382-do-control-status-and-xhci-5s-status-stage.md))

Do not rely on:

- ~~The 5 s is a host xHC bug.~~ **R05** `RETRACTED` ([E0386](../evidence/0386-runb16-depcmd-cmdstatus-and-ring-verdict.md)); see C04: Root cause: missed Status OUT handshake. The host sends its single Status OUT right after DATA-IN, before the threaded IRQ arms the status TRB; DWC3 NAKs it (recorded NRDY(STATUS)); no later Status OUT completes the armed TRB. *Note: E0387 replaced this reading; E0471 places the cause in the handshake window, not a host defect.*
- ~~UCX ETW payloads are pointer/TRB-level only, so setup packets and status cannot be decoded from the host capture.~~ **R12** `RETRACTED` ([E0357](../evidence/0357-run-b3-get-cur-never-delivered-and-class-translation-fix.md)); see C30: With the UCX provider and tracerpt XML, control URBs can be extracted with their setup packets, durations and USBD_STATUS (B17/B18 decodes).
